Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The English players make their way out to the middle. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks are the openers for South Africa. Sam Curran to start with the ball. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, England have a mammoth total on the board. South Africa do have the batting but they need to bat out of their skins to win this one. Can South Africa pull off this chase? It will be quite a fascinating one if they manage to get anywhere close to this target. Stay tuned for South Africa's reply.

South African bowlers were carted all around the park and it was Lungi Ngidi who stood out for the visitors despite all the carnage around the him. He ended with a five-wicket haul and he along with Rabada and Maharaj were the reasons that stopped England from crossing 250 on this very flat deck. South Africa were poor in the field too and dropped Jonny Bairstow three times and that cost them heavily in the end.

England lost both their openers in the Powerplay but does that make any difference to this power-packed English side? It surely did not make any difference today. Malan and Bairstow put together a counter-attacking third-wicket partnership and though Malan departed after playing a fine knock of 43, there was no respite for South African bowlers. Things went from bad to worse as Bairstow and Moeen Ali went berserk as England hammered 87 runs in the last five overs. Moeen Ali scored a quickfire fifty while Bairstow played a superb knock of 90 runs.

This was England at their absolute best! There has been a lot of talk about whether they should continue with their attacking approach or not after the series loss against India but we think that all those questions have been answered today. Unfortunately for South Africa, there were on the receiving end of carnage and now have a humongous task in front of them.

Lungi Ngidi serves this full and angling into the pads, Chris Jordan looks to work this leg side and misses. Hits the pads and rolls over towards cover for a leg bye. That brings an end to a wonderful batting display by England who will be very happy with the score on the board.
Chris Jordan is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, a catch has been taken! Lungi Ngidi bowls a slower delivery fraction full and outside off, Jonny Bairstow looks to go straight but mistimes it high into the air towards mid-wicket. Rilee Rossouw keeps his eyes on the ball and settles himself under this one. Takes a nervous catch and Jonny Bairstow's wonderful innings has come to an end. He has taken England to an above par score.
Commentary.Howout: c Rilee Rossouw b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: This is in a good length, and on off, Sam Curran pulls this over mid-wicket who gets a hand to it. They take a single and another difficult chance put down.
Sam Curran is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Liam Livingstone has to depart and Jonny Bairstow is still off strike! Lungi Ngidi serves a slower delivery on a good length outside off, Liam Livingstone gets down the wicket and looks to thump the ball offside. Gets a thin outside edge through to the keeper and Quinton de Kock makes no mistake behind the wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Another yorker straying down leg, Liam Livingstone connects as he flicks this to the left of short fine leg for a boundary to deep backward square leg.

Lungi Ngidi begins with a yorker speared into the pads, Jonny Bairstow looks to work this leg side and gets hit on the pads. the ball rolls to fine leg for a leg bye. South Africa decide to review. UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved but the ball is pitching outside leg. South Africa lose their review.
On a good length outside off, Jonny Bairstow pulls this straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is a fraction short outside off, Jonny Bairstow looks to pull this leg side and gets an underedge down into the pitch.
Great comeback from Kagiso Rabada as he serves a yorker just missing off stump. Jonny Bairstow swings and misses.

SIX! This has been clobbered! Kagiso Rabada bowls this on a length and outside off. Sits up nicely for Jonny Bairstow who pulls this towards the deep square leg boundary for another maximum! What a hit!
On the shorter side, outside off. Liam Livingstone drags it to long off for a single.
A yorker on middle. Jonny Bairstow looks to dig it out but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side for a single.
This is fuller and outside off. Liam Livingstone looks to power it away but misses.
Liam Livingstone is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! So that will be the end of this fantastic knock and an even better partnership between Jonny Bairstow and Moeen Ali. Ngidi though does well here to bowl it full and outside off. Ali goes chasing for it but ends up getting an outside edge back to the keeper. Quinton de Kock takes the catch and Lungi Ngidi gets his third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker on off. Ali blocks it out.
SIX! Wow! What a shot to get to his fifty! It comes off just 16 deliveries - the fastest for England in T20Is. This is full on middle. Ali just flicks it aerially over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
WIDE! Lungi Ngidi goes full down leg side. The umpires calls wide and the Free Hit remains.

NO BALL! This is on a good length and outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to heave this leg side and top edges it into the vacant mid-wicket region for a single. The bowler has overstepped and another Free Hit!

FOUR! That is another drop from South Africa! They have been absolutely dismal in the field today! Lungi Ngidi goes full on the pads, Jonny Bairstow flicks this towards deep square leg and goes to the left of Heinrich Klaasen who lets it through his hands and concedes a boundary!

FOUR! There is no respite here for South Africa! Lungi Ngidi serves a full toss outside off, Jonny Bairstow gets his bat to it and guides the ball to the deep backward point boundary for four more runs!

SIX! Make it five! What an over for England! Andile Phehlukwayo serves this full outside off, Moeen Ali strokes this straight over long off for another maximum! This is pure carnage! Andile Phehlukwayo has conceded 33 runs in this over!

SIX! Fourth six of the over! Andile Phehlukwayo is being taken to the cleaners here! Andile Phehlukwayo comes 'round the wicket and serves this on a good length and angling down leg. Moeen Ali flicks this off his legs and lifts the ball over the fine leg boundary for a biggie!

SIX! There is no respite for South African bowlers here. What a hitting this has been from both these batters. A slower length delivery, around off. Ali skips down the track and launches it over deep extra-cover for a maximum.

Ohh... Jonny Bairstow has been dropped again! This is Jonny Bairstow's night for sure! On a length and outside off. Jonny Bairstow fetches it from outside off and ends up getting a top edge here. The ball goes high in the air towards long on and Reeza Hendricks there puts down a sitter! A single taken.
WIDE! This is pressure! This is on a length and way outside off. Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone.
WIDE! This is on a length and outside off. It is way outside off and Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone.
SIX! Wow! What a shot! Andile Phehlukwayo delivers it right in the slot on middle. Jonny Bairstow swipes it over deep square leg for a biggie.
SIX! It is carnage out there! Andile Phehlukwayo with a slower short delivery, around off. Jonny Bairstow picks the length quickly and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Andile Phehlukwayo to continue.
This is short and outside off, Moeen Ali hits this hard straight towards long on and takes a couple of runs. 20 runs of the over and the Tristan Stubbs experiment has not worked!

NO BALL AND SIX! Things going all wrong for South Africa! Moeen Ali gets down the wicket and flicks a full delivery on his pads wide of deep square leg. Just manages to beat the diving fielder as it goes over the ropes for a maximum! Tristan Stubbs has overstepped and England have a Free Hit now!
Tristan Stubbs bowls this quicker and full in line with the stumps. Jonny Bairstow works this to long on for a single.

DROPPED! Tristan Stubbs almost had his man! Tristan Stubbs serves this full and angles this into the stumps, Jonny Bairstow looks to heave this leg side and mistime it high into the air. Rilee Rossouw comes in from deep mid-wicket and settles himself under the ball. It goes right through his hands and South Africa have been really poor in the field today! Another chance goes begging!
SIX! Stand and deliver! Tristan Stubbs goes full and into the stumps, Jonny Bairstow lifts this straight over long on for a biggie! Jonny Bairstow is putting up quite a show here!
Tristan Stubbs serves this full and angling down leg, Moeen Ali gets down the wicket and taps the ball towards mid-wicket for a single. 150 comes up for England.
Tristan Stubbs begins with a full toss outside off, Jonny Bairstow knocks the ball to long on for a single.
Fifty for Jonny Bairstow! His rich vein of form continues. Slower and fuller outside off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to long off for a single. What a home summer this has been for Jonny Bairstow!
On a length, on off. Ali drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary! Andile Phehlukwayo keeps it a tad short on middle. Ali makes room and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! England continue to find boundaries at regular intervals! A short delivery on off. Ali pulls it without much fuss over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow cuts it to point for a single.

WIDE! Another slower delivery. This is way outside off and Jonny Bairstow leaves it. The ball goes off the bounce to the keeper. Quinton de Kock fails to collect it cleanly but no extra run taken. Wided!
Back of a length, on off. It is a slower one and Jonny Bairstow plays it back to the bowler.
Bit fuller on middle. Jonny Bairstow works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 14 runs from the over!

SIX! Shamsi has been way too short today and has paid the price for it. This is a nothing delivery, a short one on off. Jonny Bairstow goes deep in his crease and launches it over cow corner for a maximum.
Tossed up on middle. Ali sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! This is pitched wider outside off and it turns away. Ali looks to cut it but misses.
A half-tracker on middle. Jonny Bairstow pulls it aerially but the ball falls well short of the deep mid-wicket fielder. A single taken.
On the shorter side, around off. Jonny Bairstow cuts it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
WIDE! Shamsi tries to stay away from the hitting arc of Jonny Bairstow and ends up bowling it way too wide outside off. Jonny Bairstow leaves it.
Tossed up, outside off. Ali drives it to deep extra-cover for another single.
A slower length delivery, outside off. Ali drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! Rabada bangs it short on middle. Ali hooks it and does it quite well as he hits in the gap towards the square leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow guides it to third man for a single.
Overpitched outside off. Ali drives it to extra-cover for a single.
A fullish delivery, around off. Ali drives but straight to the cover fielder.
A length delivery on the stumps. Jonny Bairstow works it to fine leg for a single.
Moeen Ali is the new batter out in the middle. Kagiso Rabada has been brought back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A wicket against the run of play here! Malan was looking so good out in the middle but he has to walk back now as Andile Phehlukwayo gets rid of him in the last ball of the over. This is on a length and outside off. It is not an off-pace delivery this time and Malan looks to cut it. He, however, only manages to get an outside edge back to the keeper and Quinton de Kock behind the stumps takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Andile Phehlukwayo

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Now he brings out his favourite shot! This is a slower delivery and fuller outside off. Malan drives it inside-out over extra-cover for a boundary.
SIX! Malan is looking in supreme touch today! Serves another slower delivery. However, it is in the slot this time on off. Malan picks it up and deposits it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Andile Phehlukwayo bowls it slower and full outside off. Malan looks to drive it away but ends up getting the inside half of his blade and the ball goes back to the keeper.
On a length, on middle. Jonny Bairstow punches it to long on for a single.
A fullish delivery on leg. Jonny Bairstow looks to flick it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards the keeper.
So just a single to end the over! Brilliant stuff from Keshav Maharaj! This is fuller on off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to long off for a single.
Goes fuller and around off. Jonny Bairstow tries to drive it away but gets the inside half of his blade and the ball rolls towards the leg side.
Quicker and shorter outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to cut but misses.
A fuller delivery on middle. Malan hits it firmly to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Jonny Bairstow dances down the track and looks to launch it straight down the ground. He gets the inside edge past stumps to short fine leg for a single.
Pushed quicker and around off. Jonny Bairstow goes for the slog-sweep but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes towards short third man.

DRINKS! This has been a good positive start from England. They are staying true to their attacking approach and that has meant that they are scoring at almost 10 runs an over despite losing two wickets in the Powerplay. Shamsi has been every expensive in his two overs and South Africa need to break this partnership otherwise things can drift away from them quite quickly.

Tabraiz Shamsi is short once again outside off, Jonny Bairstow is on the backfoot but cannot get this away as he mistimes it to long on for a single. 21 runs from this over and England will be absolutely thrilled.
WIDE! Fires this quick down leg, Dawid Malan looks to work this fine and misses. The keeper fumbles behind the wicket and they get an extra wide run.
Bowls this full outside off, Jonny Bairstow works this towards mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! This is proving to be a really expensive over for South Africa! Tabraiz Shamsi is under serious pressure as he drops this short and in ine with the stumps. Jonny Bairstow connects this even better and gets it well over the deep square leg fence for a maximum!

FOUR! Another poor delivery and gets what it deserves! Tabraiz Shamsi serves a half tracker on middle and off, Jonny Bairstow makes room to pull this leg side but the ball takes forever to reach him. He still manages to connect well and get it wide of long off for four more runs!
This is full and outside off, Dawid Malan guides this to deep point for a single.

SIX! Dawid Malan has got a hold of this one! Tabraiz Shamsi flights this full outside off and gets Dawid Malan to get down the wicket. He connects well as this flies over the cover fielder and hits the deep cover ropes on the full. Dawid Malan is looking in fine nick here.
Fraction short again. Malan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On the shorter side, outside off. Jonny Bairstow cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Jonny Bairstow skips down the track and plays it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller on middle. Malan works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Keeps it on the shorter side, around off. Jonny Bairstow punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter and tad shorter one, around off. Jonny Bairstow looks to cut but misses it.
A quicker delivery on middle. Jonny Bairstow drives it to long on for a single.

SIX! That is a missed opportunity! Heinrich Klaasen has completely lost the ball in the background as the ball swishes past him over the boundary! Tabraiz Shamsi is too short once again and outside off. Jonny Bairstow pulls this towards deep mid-wicket where there is a fielder placed. Heinrich Klaasen puts his hands up but is nowhere near the ball as it goes for a maximum! Will this cost South Africa the game?
This is short as well outside off, Jonny Bairstow looks to slash at this and gets a bottom edge into the pitch. He is livid at himself for missing out here!
Serves this full outside off, Dawid Malan taps this towards cover and takes a quick single.
Good turn off the wicket. Bowls this short and pitching outside leg and gets the ball to turn to the off side. Dawid Malan fends this towards point.

SIX! Dawid Malan welcomes Tabraiz Shamsi to the crease with a maximum! Tabraiz Shamsi begins with a short delivery on middle and leg, David Willey rocks back in his crease and pulls this over deep square leg for a huge hit! Dawid Malan does not want to miss out here!
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now.

SIX! Jonny Bairstow ends the over with a bang! Keshav Maharaj goes slightly short outside off, Jonny Bairstow leans back and pulls this over the cow corner boundary for a biggie! Jonny Bairstow gets his first maximum!
Full this time and angling into the pads, Dawid Malan clips this wide of deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short once again and well outside off, Jonny Bairstow goes back in the crease and knocks the ball to long off for another single.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Dawid Malan thumps this down to long off for a single.
Goes 'round the wicket to the right-hander. Angles this into the stumps on a fuller length. Jonny Bairstow clips this to deep mid-wicket for another run.
Keshav Maharaj serves this full on middle and off, Dawid Malan works this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Keshav Maharaj is back on. He went for 13 runs in his first over!
Andile Phehlukwayo goes full this time outside off. Jonny Bairstow hits it straight to mid off. Just 5 runs of the over. England are 48-2 after the Powerplay!
Good-length delivery once again and in line with the stumps. Dawid Malan flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Goes a fraction fuller outside off, Jonny Bairstow knocks this towards mid off and takes off for a quick run.
This one is on a good length as well and pitching on middle and leg. Dawid Malan works this off his legs towards backward square leg for a single.
Serves this on the good length outside off, Jonny Bairstow guides this past the point fielder for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo begins with a good length delivery on the pads, Dawid Malan clips this through square leg for a single.

A direct-hit but that gives away an extra run to England in the end. This is a fullish delivery on off at 137 kph. Jonny Bairstow drives it just wide of mid off and sets off for a single. The fielder at mid off fires a direct hit at the bowler's end. Luckily Jonny Bairstow makes his ground and then ends up taking another run as the ball deflects towards mid-wicket after hitting the stumps.
Beaten! Ngidi serves a good-length delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to punch it away but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Jonny Bairstow punches it to cover-point.
Jonny Bairstow comes out to the middle and he will be looking to continue his good form.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lungi Ngidi gets his second wicket and both the openers are back in the hut now. Roy was struggling to find his timing today and gets completely outfoxed by this slower delivery. A slower length delivery, around off. Roy goes for a wild swing across the line. However, he gets a huge top edge as he is way early into his shot. The ball goes in the air towards backward point and Heinrich Klaasen takes a simple catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Ngidi keeps it a tad short again, on middle at 136 kph. Malan works it towards backward square leg for a single.
Back of a length, angling into middle. Roy looks to guide it towards the off side. However, he gets the inside edge past stumps to short fine leg for a single.
A very full delivery on off. Roy squeezes it to covers and takes a quick sngle. This has been a good positive start from England!
On a length, on leg. Malan works it to square leg for a single.
SIX! Stand and deliver! Lands on a length, on off. Malan stays still in his crease and hits it cleanly over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Rabada goes fuller on middle at 139 kph. Roy works it to mid-wicket.
A fullish delivery on off. Roy drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around off. Malan looks to push it away. However, he gets the inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls behind square on the leg side. A single taken.
On a length, around off. Roy punches it to covers.
Back of a length, on middle. Malan works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Dawid Malan walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a superb catch from the South African skipper David Miller! Ngidi bowls it full on off. Buttler looks to hit it down the ground again. However, he miscues it and the ball goes high in the air as he gets a top edge. The ball goes almost towards the long off region. Miller at mid off runs back and gets under it quite well to finish the catch quite comfortably in the end. These are one of the toughest catches to take and all credit goes to Miller for taking it with such class and finesse.
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Short and wide outside off at 72 mph. Buttler waits for it and cuts it through cover for a boundary.
SIX! Early signs of aggression from Buttler! This is full on off. Buttler stays still in his crease and launches it over long off for a maximum.
On a length, on middle. Roy works it to fine leg for a single.
The fast bowler has done much better than the spinner and with the conditions quite overcast it would be better to stick to pace.
WIDE! Roy walks down the track and Ngidi drifts down the leg side. Roy looks to clip it but misses.
Rabada bowls it straight again, on middle. Roy tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Rabada angles it on middle and leg. Roy looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
An appeal for an LBW but it is turned down. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Roy looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, around leg. Roy makes a bit of room and swings across the line but misses. The ball goes over the leg stump.
Goes fuller on middle. Buttler drives it to mid on and a single taken again.
On a length, on middle. Roy plays it a bit early and it hits high on the blade as he looks to work it towards the leg side. A single taken towards mid on.
Kagiso Rabada to start from the other end.
SIX! Jos Buttler ends the first over with a maximum! This is on the shorter side, on off. Buttler rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
A fuller delivery on middle. Roy works it to mid on for a single.

This is short once again outside off, Jos Buttler hits this towards deep cover for a single. Heinrich Klaasen takes some pace off the ball at cover as he dives to stop this. The crowd appreciates his effort this time.

FOUR! First boundary for England! Keshav Maharaj serves this a fraction short outside off, Jos Buttler knocks this towards cover and shouts no. Heinrich Klaasen at cover makes an absolute mess of this as some awkward bounce takes the ball between his legs to the deep cover boundary for four runs! England have the ball rolling.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Jason Roy sweep this to square leg and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Keshav Maharaj serves this a fraction short in line with the stumps, Jason Roy looks to cut and misses as the ball beats his outside edge and the stumps.
We are all set for the action to begin. The English openers Jason Roy and Jos Buttler have walked out to the middle. Keshav Maharaj will begin proceedings with the ball.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Rilee Rossouw, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller (C), Tristan Stubbs, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (C) (WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Moeen Ali, Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Richard Gleeson, Reece Topley.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

There is ample quality in both the squads and this may well prove to be a cracker of a contest, provided the rain gods allow us to witness this battle. Of the six T20Is played at the venue, five have been won by the team chasing. Will the team that wins the toss choose to chase? Stay tuned for the toss in a bit…
